svg.title: Tech stack
svg.desc: Frontend: TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Next.js, Angular, Tailwind CSS. Backend: Java, Spring Boot, Node.js, NestJS, Express. Data: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis. Infra & Tooling: Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Jenkins, Git, Postman. Also: Oracle, Cassandra, OpenSearch, OpenShift, RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ, Liquibase, Resilience4j.
